checkpoints.label: Opening guidance
checkpoints.caveat: Opening guidance excluded the then-announced in-tech acquisition; later guidance included it.

guidance.interpretation: FY25 growth beat early expectations but finished 0.3 percentage points below the final January guidance floor. A forecast revision is not quarterly guidance; all four checkpoints target the same full fiscal year.

annual.cashCaveat: Company-reported FCF follows IFRS. Do not subtract Ind AS capex from Ind AS CFO and label the result as this company-reported IFRS FCF.

indAsCashFlow.basis: Ind AS consolidated cash flow; distinct from reported IFRS free cash flow

annual.businessSummary: Technology services and consulting across financial services, manufacturing, retail, communications and other industries.

derivedOperatingEbitda.definition: Operating profit plus reported depreciation and amortization expense; excludes other income. Calculated, not company-labeled EBITDA.
derivedOperatingEbitda.caveat: The Q4 FY25 reported D&A line includes INR188 crore impairment of customer-related intangible assets (Ind AS results PDFp23). Adding back the full line includes this impairment add-back. Keep the definition visible.

analysis.title: Growth missed the final promise
analysis.body: FY25 constant-currency revenue growth of 4.2% fell 0.3 percentage points below January's 4.5% floor, despite beating the opening forecast.

analysis.title: What changed in Q4
analysis.body: Management attributed about two-thirds of the 3.5% sequential constant-currency decline to lower third-party costs; remaining weakness reflected volumes and seasonality. This is management's explanation, not independent proof.

analysis.title: Cash supports earnings, with a caveat
analysis.body: Reported free-cash-flow conversion was 129.2%. Management's tax-refund-adjusted conversion was 112%, still above net profit but lower than the headline.

analysis.title: Margins held up better than growth
analysis.body: FY25 operating margin of 21.1% remained within the 20–22% guidance range. Revenue and margin guidance deserve separate verdicts.

dataDiscipline: All page numbers are one-based PDF page numbers unless explicitly marked printed pages.
Annual report covers FY25 but was available only after the April results. Research dossier uses 30 June 2025 as-of date, separate from the April inbox replay.
Document date for a transcript is the call date, not necessarily its publication date.
EBITDA is null because the selected quarterly press-release tables provide operating profit, not EBITDA. Never relabel operating profit as EBITDA.
PAT attributable to owners is used consistently for per-share investor comparisons. Total PAT includes non-controlling interests.
INR reported growth differs from constant-currency growth. The guidance ledger uses constant currency only.
QoQ and YoY are computed from exact cited values. Quarter totals can differ from annual totals through published rounding.
No recommendation or price target is inferred. Bull and bear interpretations require labeled evidence.
